value.title: Held expiry follows the message identity

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR314 R1 at 2ad9e18: two independent real-SQLite/DeliveryService witnesses found that an expired same-ID copy can emit NOT-delivered while an unexpired copy is pending, and that a live-duplicate guard missing kind/recipient can strand another recipient after renewal clears its lapse. Judge terminal expiry across the scoped recipient/origin/message identity, not just one parked row. Match duplicate guards to the actual queue key (kind, origin, msg_id); the existing index then replaces a live-state scan. A 64-new-send brake is not a bound on preaccepted queue rows parked by reconciliation. Difficulties: exact-head CI passed all existing tests, mutation logs were not retained, and shared-build waits dominated local proof. MagicWand: add duplicate-deadline and distinct-recipient same-ID regressions and retain per-mutant command/exit/log receipts. Both behavioral bugs and the 65-row cap witness reproduced in an isolated exact-head archive; review worktree untouched and temporary archive removed.
